item.title: Welcome to the Cass Sports Network – Your Home for Colonels Athletics!
item.description: We’re excited to officially introduce the Cass Sports Network – your go-to source for everything Cass Colonels! Whether you’re a proud parent, a devoted fan, or a Cass student-athlete, this is the place where Cass pride meets coverage.As part of the Cassville community, we know how much heart and hustle goes into every game, every meet, and every match.
